description: Form 990 history by EIN with extracted financials, form-specific compensation, and PDF-only returns. Optional inclusive from_year/to_year bounds select fiscal years across both histories; omitted bounds return full history. Unfiltered totals remain available. Records are sorted by full tax period without amendment precedence. Empty dataset history succeeds with BMF context; an empty selected window does not imply no history. Data lags 1–2 years; always cite tax_prd_yr. Data from ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer and IRS Form 990 filings.

anyOf.description: EIN as integer (e.g., 530196605). Leading zeros are stripped — treat EIN as an integer key.
EIN as string, with or without hyphen (e.g., "53-0196605" or "530196605").

ein.description: Employer Identification Number. Use nonprofit_search_organizations to resolve an org name to its EIN.

from_year.description: Inclusive minimum fiscal year (tax_prd_yr). Omit for no lower bound.

to_year.description: Inclusive maximum fiscal year (tax_prd_yr). Omit for no upper bound.

name: nonprofit_get_filings

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_year_range`: from_year is greater than to_year. `timeout`: A ProPublica API attempt expires before its response body finishes. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: The complete ProPublica API retry exchange exceeds its deadline. `not_found`: The EIN does not correspond to a known organization in the Nonprofit Explorer database. `upstream_error`: ProPublica API returns a non-JSON body or network error. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

filings.description: Filings with extracted financial data, sorted newest first.

items.description: Form 990 filing with extracted financial data for one fiscal year.

contributions_and_grants.description: Contributions and grants in USD: totcntrbgfts (990), totcntrbs (990-EZ), or grscontrgifts (990-PF). Null when not extracted.

distributable_amount.description: 990-PF required distributable amount in USD, Part X line 7, distribamt. A payout requirement, not actual payments or a compliance measure. Null for other forms or when not extracted.

executive_compensation.description: Executive compensation summary. 990-EZ is unextracted; see Part IV of its PDF. Supported-form missing amounts remain null.

amount.description: Total executive compensation in USD. Null when absent on supported 990/PF forms; always null on 990-EZ because the source does not extract it.

field_name.description: Source API field: compnsatncurrofcr on 990, compofficers on 990-PF. Null on 990-EZ, which has no extracted officer-compensation field.

form_type.description: Form type this compensation field is sourced from.

note.description: Plain-English description of what this field covers and where to find per-officer detail.

fair_market_value_assets.description: 990-PF end-of-year fair-market-value assets in USD, header Item I, fairmrktvalamt. Null for other forms or when not extracted.

fundraising_events_direct_expenses.description: 990 VIII 8b lessdirfndrsng, USD. Null when unextracted or inapplicable to EZ/PF; EZ combines gaming and events separately.

fundraising_events_gross.description: Event gross income excluding separately reported contributions: 990 VIII 8a grsincfndrsng or EZ I 6b grsrevnuefndrsng, USD. Null when unextracted or inapplicable to PF.

fundraising_events_net.description: 990 VIII 8c netincfndrsng, USD; may be negative. Null when unextracted or inapplicable to EZ/PF.

gaming_and_fundraising_direct_expenses.description: EZ I 6c direxpns, USD, combined gaming and fundraising expenses. Null when unextracted or inapplicable to 990/PF.

gaming_and_fundraising_net.description: EZ I 6d netincfndrsng, USD, combined gaming and fundraising net. Null when unextracted or inapplicable to 990/PF.

grants_paid.description: 990-PF contributions, gifts, and grants paid in USD, Part I line 25 column (a), contrpdpbks. Null for other forms or when not extracted.

investment_income.description: Investment income in USD: invstmntinc (990), othrinvstinc (990-EZ), or intrstrvnue plus dividndsamt (990-PF Part I column (a), lines 3–4: savings interest plus dividends and securities interest; excludes capital gains, rents, and net investment income). PF requires both components; null when not extracted.

net_assets.description: Net assets/fund balances (end of year) in USD. From totnetassetend (990), totnetassetsend (990-EZ), or tfundnworth (990-PF). Null when not extracted.

net_investment_income.description: 990-PF net investment income in USD, Part I line 27b, netinvstinc. Null for other forms or when not extracted.

other_salaries_and_wages.description: 990 Part IX line 7A, othrsalwages, USD. Null when unextracted or inapplicable to EZ/PF.

payroll_taxes.description: 990 Part IX line 10A, payrolltx, USD. Null when unextracted or inapplicable to EZ/PF.

pdf_url.description: Source Form 990 PDF link. Null for some IRS processing batches — check filings_pdf_only.

professional_fundraising_fees.description: 990 Part IX line 11eA, profndraising, USD. Null when unextracted or inapplicable to EZ/PF.

fundraising_expenses.description: Professional fundraising fees (profndraising) in USD. Null when not reported.

management_compensation.description: Officer/director/trustee compensation (compnsatncurrofcr) in USD. Null when not reported.

note.description: Methodology note naming the source of the functional allocation.

other_salaries.description: Other salaries and wages (othrsalwages) in USD. Null when not reported.

program_expenses.description: Program-service expenses in USD — Form 990 Part IX column (B), line 25.

ratio.description: Program-service expenses divided by total functional expenses, as a decimal 0.0–1.0. Always null against the current data source, which reports no program-service expense total.

total_expenses.description: Total functional expenses in USD — Form 990 Part IX column (A). From totfuncexpns.

program_expense_ratio.description: Always null against the current data source. ProPublica returns no Form 990 Part IX column (B) program-service expense total, and the functional allocation across program, management, and fundraising cannot be reconstructed from the fields it does return. Read Part IX of the filing at pdf_url for the split.

program_service_revenue.description: Program service revenue in USD: totprgmrevnue (990) or prgmservrev (990-EZ). Not applicable for 990-PF.

tax_prd.description: YYYYMM month the fiscal year ended (e.g., 202306 = June 2023 fiscal year end).

tax_prd_yr.description: Fiscal year of this filing (e.g., 2023). NOT the filing date — data lags 1–2 years. Always cite.

total_assets.description: Total assets (end of year) in USD. Null when not extracted.

total_expenses.description: Total expenses in USD. Null when not extracted.

total_liabilities.description: Total liabilities (end of year) in USD. Null when not extracted.

total_revenue.description: Total revenue in USD. Null when not extracted.

updated.description: ISO datetime ProPublica last updated this record. Null when not provided.

filings_pdf_only.description: PDF-only returns sorted by full tax period, retaining equal-period entries.

items.description: Return with a PDF link but no extracted financial data; may be newer than extracted history.

form_type_str.description: Form type string as returned by API ("990", "990EZ", "990PF").

pdf_url.description: Source Form 990 PDF link. Null for some batches.

tax_prd.description: YYYYMM tax period. Null when absent from the PDF-only record.

from_year.description: Applied inclusive lower fiscal-year bound. Null when omitted.

notice.description: Present only when the complete dataset history is empty, with BMF context and no inferred cause. A selected window can be empty while unfiltered totals show existing history.

propublica_url.description: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer URL for this org.

to_year.description: Applied inclusive upper fiscal-year bound. Null when omitted.

total_filings_pdf_only.description: Unfiltered count of PDF-only filings (no extracted data).

total_filings_with_data.description: Unfiltered count of filings with extracted financial data.

title: Get Nonprofit Filings
